For escalated issues ☎ +1-855-732-4023 (US) or +1-(855)-(732)-4023) (INTL) Celebrity Cruise || , prepare detailed documentation, including your itinerary number, and ask for the supervisory desk. To escalate an issue with Celebrity Cruise 💥 ☎ +1-855-732-4023 (US) or +1-(855)-(732)-4023) (INTL) 💥[U*S] Celebrity Cruise travelers can contact support and request escalation to a supervisor for faster resolution of problems related to Celebrity Cruise hotel booking, flight reservations, cancellations, or refund delays.
